method: Read and compare closed artifacts only; no new test, build, actor, provider call, journal read or replay. Raw file digests and admitted semantic coordinates are distinct domains.

selectedAuthority.basis: Previously read selected authority, not migration or requalification.

cases.ordinaryTaskRequest: Implement the complete selected original source. Preserve all source obligations and unresolved meaning. The predecessor vector mechanism is not runtime authority: use the current native lifecycle. Admitted native execution and Evidence replace the old hand-written execution-result representation; do not prewrite claimed execution success.

helperArtifact.semanticCoordinateCheck: Coordinates equal admitted provenance; owner artifactDigest is not asserted to be raw-file SHA256.

cases.limits: One completed attempt; no general ABG/GLC qualification, stochastic reliability or rewrite of native terminal status.
